The notes provide the precise definition cited in the claim.

Topologically Defined Isosurfaces is a method for extracting a topologically correct, closed, oriented 2-manifold isosurface from a binary volumetric image by modifying the Marching Cubes configuration table based on digital geometry connectedness [S1].

The source details the modification of the configuration table based on connectedness couples (n, lambda) chosen from {6, 18, 26} adjacencies to ensure topological correctness.
